1430|0c543544.name: Tomas
1430|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

1430|b48f927f.name: Tomas
1430|b48f927f.text: I can teach you how to cook!

2329|a28d29e1.name: Michelle Belle
2329|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

247226|58a0ba23.name: Kelsey Fargo
247226|58a0ba23.text: Blast these kobolds. I can't get any work done with them running back and forth, getting in my way. Well, I've got nothing better to do, would you like to learn about mining techniques? Or perhaps you just need some new tools?

247229|55b52cc4.name: Daniel
247229|55b52cc4.text: What does Brother Paxton need now?

248415|bdfaa98c.name: Tordrin Sternblade
248415|bdfaa98c.text: I heard ol' Marshal McBride was sendin' ye' my way.

514|aa4da6d8.name: Smith Argus
514|aa4da6d8.text: If you'd like to learn how to blacksmith your own weapons and armor, I'd be happy to help.

823|b02f6a36.name: Deputy Willem
823|b02f6a36.text: Hello there, $c.  Normally I'd be out on the beat looking after the folk of Stormwind, but a lot of the Stormwind guards are fighting in other lands.  So here I am, deputized and offering bounties when I'd rather be on patrol...

911|7a171557.name: Llane Beshere
911|7a171557.text: Stormwind is the pillar of the $r race, maintained through strength of will and the edge of a sturdy blade.

913|7a171557.name: Lyria Du Lac
913|7a171557.text: Stormwind is the pillar of the $r race, maintained through strength of will and the edge of a sturdy blade.

927|837f02f9.name: Brother Wilhelm
927|837f02f9.text: May the Light protect you this day.

15-accept.name: Marshal McBride
15-accept.text:
$N, my scouts tell me that the kobold infestation is larger than we had thought.  A group of kobold workers has camped near the Echo Ridge Mine to the north.

Go to the mine and remove them.  We know there are at least 10.  Kill them, see if there are more, then report back to me.
15-accept.title: Investigate Echo Ridge

18-accept.name: Deputy Willem
18-accept.text:
Recently, a new group of thieves has been hanging around Northshire.  They call themselves the Defias Brotherhood, and have been seen across the river to the east.

I don't know what they're up to, but I'm sure it's not good!  Bring me the bandanas they wear, and I'll reward you with a weapon.
18-accept.title: Brotherhood of Thieves

18-complete.name: Deputy Willem
18-complete.text: Back with some bandanas, I see.  The Stormwind Army appreciates your help.
18-complete.title: Brotherhood of Thieves

18-progress.name: Deputy Willem
18-progress.text: Have you gathered those bandanas for me yet?
18-progress.title: Brotherhood of Thieves

21-complete.name: Marshal McBride
21-complete.text: Once again, you have earned my respect, and the gratitude of the Stormwind Army.  There may yet be kobolds in the mine, but I will marshal others against them.  We have further tasks for you.
21-complete.title: Skirmish at Echo Ridge

2158-accept.name: Falkhaan Isenstrider
2158-accept.text:
Every adventurer should rest when exhaustion sets in - and there is no finer place to get rest and relaxation than at the Lion's Pride Inn!

My best friend, Innkeeper Farley, runs the Lion's Pride. If you tell him I sent you, he may give you the special discounted rates on food and drink.

To find the Lion's Pride Inn, travel south along the road from here -- you can't miss it!
2158-accept.title: Rest and Relaxation

2158-complete.name: Innkeeper Farley
2158-complete.text:
Rest and relaxation for the tired and cold -- that's our motto! Please, take a seat by the fire and rest your weary bones.

Would you like to try a sampling of some of our fine food and drink?
2158-complete.title: Rest and Relaxation

3100-accept.name: Marshal McBride
3100-accept.text: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, $N. It appears to be a letter sealed with the insignia of Llane, our local $c trainer. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.
3100-accept.title: Simple Letter

3100-complete.name: Llane Beshere
3100-complete.text:
Get yourself squared away, learn the layout of the land, and come back to me whenever you need training. I'll be here night or day.

The Knights of the Silver Hand have done well in making this place fairly safe, but as you meet the other citizens, I think you'll find they all have problems they could use some help with--help a $c can give them. Good luck.
3100-complete.title: Simple Letter

3100-progress.name: Llane Beshere
3100-progress.text:
Ah, you got my letter, $N... good.

There's been an influx of warriors in Elwynn recently--which is good for Stormwind, but bad for the kobolds and Defias in the area.
3100-progress.title: Simple Letter

33-complete.name: Eagan Peltskinner
33-complete.text:
You've been busy!  I can't wait to cook up that wolf meat...

I have some things here you might want - take your pick!
33-complete.title: Wolves Across the Border

33-progress.name: Eagan Peltskinner
33-progress.text: Hey $N.  I'm getting hungry...did you get that tough wolf meat?
33-progress.title: Wolves Across the Border

3903-accept.name: Deputy Willem
3903-accept.text:
You've shown yourself a dependable $c, $N.  Dependable, and not afraid to get your hands dirty, eh?

I have a friend, Milly Osworth, who's in some trouble.  She's over with her wagon on the other side of the abbey, near the stable.  I'm sure she could use a pair of hands like yours.
3903-accept.title: Milly Osworth

3903-complete.name: Milly Osworth
3903-complete.text:
Oh, Deputy Willem told you to speak with me?  He's a brave man and always willing to help, but his duties keep him stuck at Northshire Abbey and I'm afraid the problem I have today is beyond him.

Perhaps you can help me?
3903-complete.title: Milly Osworth

3904-accept.name: Milly Osworth
3904-accept.text:
A gang of brigands, the Defias, moved into the Northshire Vineyards while I was harvesting!  I reported it to the Northshire guards and they assured me they'd take care of things, but... I'm afraid for my crop of grapes!  If the Defias don't steal them then I fear our guards will trample them when they chase away the thugs.

Please, you must help me!  I gathered most of my grapes into buckets, but I left them in the vineyards to the southeast.

Bring me those crates!  Save my harvest!
3904-accept.title: Milly's Harvest

3904-complete.name: Milly Osworth
3904-complete.text:
Oh thank you, $N!  You saved my harvest!  And I hope you showed a few of those Defias that they can't cause trouble around here.

We might be short on guards these days, but we're lucky to have heroes like you to protect us!
3904-complete.title: Milly's Harvest

3905-accept.name: Milly Osworth
3905-accept.text:
Now that my crop is saved, take this Grape Manifest to Brother Neals.  He manages the store of food and drink in Northshire, and I'm sure he'll be delighted to hear that he has fresh grapes.

You'll find Brother Neals in the abbey, in the bell tower... where he likes to taste his wine.
3905-accept.title: Grape Manifest

3905-complete.name: Brother Neals
3905-complete.text:
Let's see here...

Oh my!  Milly's grapes have been saved!  When she told me that brigands overran her vineyards I nearly despaired, but my faith in the Light did not waver!

And through your bravery,  we now have grapes for more wine!  May the Light bless you, $N, and keep you safe!
3905-complete.title: Grape Manifest

3905-progress.name: Brother Neals
3905-progress.text: You look to be in fine spirits!  Come!  Have a seat, and have a drink!
3905-progress.title: Grape Manifest

47-accept.name: Remy "Two Times"
47-accept.text:
The Kobolds in these parts sometimes carry Gold Dust on them.  I could really use the stuff - bring me a load of it and I'll give you the best price in town...best price in town!

You can find kobolds in the Fargodeep Mine to the south, and around the Jasperlode Mine to the northeast.
47-accept.title: Gold Dust Exchange

54-accept.name: Marshal McBride
54-accept.text:
$N, you are a $c with proven interest in the security of Northshire.  You are now tasked with the protection of the surrounding Elwynn Forest.

If you accept this duty, then I have prepared papers that must be delivered to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.  Goldshire lies along the southern road, past the border gates.
54-accept.title: Report to Goldshire

54-complete.name: Marshal Dughan
54-complete.text:
Well, it says here that you've been awarded Acting Deputy Status with the Stormwind Marshals.  Congratulations.

And good luck - keeping Elwynn safe is no picnic... what with most the army busy doing who knows what for who knows which noble!

It's hard to keep track of politics in these dark days...
54-complete.title: Report to Goldshire

54-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
54-progress.text:
You have word from McBride?  Northshire is a garden compared to Elwynn Forest, but I wonder what Marshal McBride has to report.

Here, let me have his papers...
54-progress.title: Report to Goldshire

6-accept.name: Deputy Willem
6-accept.text:
Garrick Padfoot - a cutthroat who's plagued our farmers and merchants for weeks - was seen at a shack near the vineyards, which lies east of the Abbey and across the bridge.  Bring me the villain's head, and earn his bounty!

But be wary, $N.  Garrick has gathered a gang of thugs around him.  He will not be an easy man to reach.
6-accept.title: Bounty on Garrick Padfoot

6-complete.name: Deputy Willem
6-complete.text: Hah - you caught him!  You've done Elwynn a great service, and earned a nice bounty!
6-complete.title: Bounty on Garrick Padfoot

6-progress.name: Deputy Willem
6-progress.text: Did you find Garrick's shack?  Are we finally free of that villain?
6-progress.title: Bounty on Garrick Padfoot

60-accept.name: William Pestle
60-accept.text:
Hello, good sir!  Do you have a moment?

My brother and I run an apothecary in Stormwind, and I'm here to gather large candles for their wax.  Can you help me?

You can get large candles from kobolds, and I hear rumors that kobolds are infesting the Elwynn mines ... the Fargodeep mine to the south and Jasperlode Mine to the east.  I suggest looking for candles in one of those places.
60-accept.title: Kobold Candles

62-accept.name: Marshal Dughan
62-accept.text:
The mine in Northshire isn't the only one with problems!  I have reports that the Fargodeep Mine in Elwynn has also become a haven for Kobolds.

Explore the mine and confirm these reports, then return to me.  The mine is almost due south of Goldshire, between the Stonefield and Maclure homesteads.
62-accept.title: The Fargodeep Mine

7-complete.name: Marshal McBride
7-complete.text:
Well done, citizen.  Those kobolds are thieves and cowards, but in large numbers they pose a threat to us.  And the humans of Stormwind do not need another threat.

For defeating them, you have my gratitude.
7-complete.title: Kobold Camp Cleanup

91741-accept.name: Unknown
91741-accept.text:
<One of the kobolds dropped this book. It looks like the kobold might have tried to eat it.

Brother Paxton inside the abbey has a small library he maintains. The book must have come from there.>
91741-accept.title: Nibbled-On Book

91741-complete.name: Brother Paxton
91741-complete.text:
Hey! How did you end up with that? It's supposed to be on the shelf! Oh dear, the kobolds have been stealing my books again. They must want to eat them!

Thanks for bringing back the book, but what will I do about the rest of my missing collection?
91741-complete.title: Nibbled-On Book

91741-progress.name: Brother Paxton
91741-progress.text: What's that you got there? It looks like one of my books.
91741-progress.title: Nibbled-On Book

91743-accept.name: Brother Paxton
91743-accept.text: Those awful kobolds are eating my books! You have to get them back before they devour my whole library.
91743-accept.title: Rascally Rodents

91743-complete.name: Brother Paxton
91743-complete.text:
Thank you so much! Here! Take one of these how-to books. I don't need them.

But there's still so many books missing. The kobolds don't seem to be eating them. So, why do they want them?
91743-complete.title: Rascally Rodents

91743-progress.name: Brother Paxton
91743-progress.text: Have you rescued my books yet, $N?!
91743-progress.title: Rascally Rodents

91745-accept.name: Brother Paxton
91745-accept.text: Go talk to the new mining apprentice, Kelsey Fargo. She works right outside the mine and has probably seen what the kobolds are up to. Maybe she can teach you a thing or two about mining while you're at it.
91745-accept.title: Mining Consultant

91745-complete.name: Kelsey Fargo
91745-complete.text: Kobolds with books? Yah, I've seen kobolds running back and forth with books, yelling at each other. They must be stealing them from the library inside the abbey.
91745-complete.title: Mining Consultant

91752-accept.name: Kelsey Fargo
91752-accept.text:
Every once in a while, a kobold comes through yelling "Picture for Narf!" I don't know who Narf is. Maybe one of the head kobolds at the back of the mine? I bet he has a whole sack of books by now.

Go get those books and bring them to our local law enforcement, Marshal McBride. You should find a friend to help. Those kobolds inside the mine are a lot meaner.
91752-accept.title: The Big Picture

91752-complete.name: Marshal McBride
91752-complete.text:
Thank you for returning these stolen books, $N. I'll get them back to Brother Paxton at once.

You're becoming quite the hero around here. Great job!
91752-complete.title: The Big Picture

91752-progress.name: Marshal McBride
91752-progress.text: Have you retrieved those stolen books yet?
91752-progress.title: The Big Picture

91758-accept.name: Marshal McBride
91758-accept.text:
You're not done with those kobolds yet. We just got word from Kelsey that a kobold left the mine carrying a large sack of books. I need you to track down this kobold so we can retrieve the books for Brother Paxton.

Go talk to Tordrin Sternblade. He's the new Hunter trainer that just arrived from Ironforge. You can find him behind the abbey, near the stable. He can help you track this kobold thief.
91758-accept.title: Follow That Kobold!

91758-complete.name: Tordrin Sternblade
91758-complete.text: I can help ye' track down this varmint. Let me whip somethin' up for ye'.
91758-complete.title: Follow That Kobold!

91772-accept.name: Tordrin Sternblade
91772-accept.text:
Alright. Take this kobold tracking kit. It'll let ye' track the kobold that Marshal McBride is concerned with.

Follow the tracks and bring what ye' find to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.

I have a feelin' these varmints are up to somethin' outside Northshire. So ye'll be needin' Dughan's help.
91772-accept.title: Shhh! We're Hunting Kobolds

91772-complete.name: Marshal Dughan
91772-complete.text:
What's this, $N? Tracking kobolds?

Well, of course they're headed toward the Fargodeep mine! That place is infested with kobolds.

Good work, I guess. I'm going to need someone to take care of that problem.
91772-complete.title: Shhh! We're Hunting Kobolds

91772-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
91772-progress.text: Have you figured out where the Kobolds are heading?
91772-progress.title: Shhh! We're Hunting Kobolds

91775-accept.name: Marshal Dughan
91775-accept.text:
While you're investigating the Fargodeep Mine, see if you can find any of Brother Paxton's books to return. In particular, Paxton is very concerned about a book titled, "Fun with Elementals". He thinks even a kobold could use it to summon an elemental servant. Be warned, the depths of the mine are fairly dangerous. You should bring friends.

Take this book bag to protect the books when you find them!
91775-accept.title: Book Return

92124-accept.name: Brother Paxton
92124-accept.text:
We need to take stock of how many books are missing!

Go talk to my useless assistant, Daniel. He can do a quick inventory and let us know how serious the problem is.

He's obsessed with the various trade professions in Elwynn Forest. The boy keeps focusing on those instead of his important work helping me.

Don't let him prattle on about tradeskills, and find out what's happened to my books!
92124-accept.title: Book Inventory

92124-complete.name: Daniel
92124-complete.text:
Yah, I overheard. I warned Brother Paxton three times about the kobolds tunneling under the abbey.

It looks like the kobolds have taken a lot of books. There are whole bookshelves emptied out. You should probably see what Brother Paxton wants you to do about it.

While you're here, can I talk to you about tradeskills? I'd be happy to answer any questions you have, or point you toward the local trainers.
92124-complete.title: Book Inventory

95998-accept.name: Sam Sarsaparilla
95998-accept.text:
Well howdy there, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. Good for you. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

It's a big wide world out there and you'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful. Not sure how your outdoorsman skills are but I reckon I could teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire, get comfy. I'll walk you through it.
95998-accept.title: The Great Outdoors

95998-complete.name: Sam Sarsaparilla
95998-complete.text: So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill. They will also teach you the know-how to create a proper camp fixture suitable to your new profession.
95998-complete.title: The Great Outdoors

96626-accept.name: Sam Sarsaparilla
96626-accept.text:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.
96626-accept.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96626-complete.name: Tomas
96626-complete.text:
With this, you'll be able to set up a camp anywhere out in the wilderness. What you've learned is just the basics, so you won't be able to place too many furnishings around it.

Raise your cooking skill and you might just be able to learn to make even bigger fires.

You can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.
96626-complete.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96627-accept.name: Marshal McBride
96627-accept.text:
$N, you have proven your competence as a protector thus far. That is why I am now entrusting you with an unusual task.

I've heard of a new adventurer down the road by Goldshire. Go and see what he's doing.
96627-accept.title: The Adventurer

96627-complete.name: Sam Sarsaparilla
96627-complete.text:
I appreciate the lookin' out, $c. That marshal's just a worrywart.

Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
96627-complete.title: The Adventurer

97923-accept.name: Sam Sarsaparilla
97923-accept.text:
Mining isn't the most glamorous, but it's good honest work and a fine profession for you to explore.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Lodestone for your camp. Build one of these and everyone who wants to swing a sword will be eager to gather round your fire and soak up the extra "oomph" it can provide to increase their combat prowess.
97923-accept.title: Camping 101: Mining
